examples.text: Wie oft hatten Sie ungeschützten Verkehr in den letzten Monaten?
examples.translation: Combien de fois avez-vous eu des rapports non protégés au cours des derniers mois ?

examples.text: Die ungeschützte linke Flanke wurde von der Infanterie angegriffen.

glosses: Not protected; lacking defence or protection; exposed.

examples.text: The dread of leaving his daughter deſolate and unprotected in a ſtrange country, had been ſo great, that he had denied himſelf even the few comforts he could have obtained, becauſe he deſired to reſerve the little money he had left to ſend her back to Warſaw, […]
A well-gilt top to a book is a great preventive against damage by dust, while to leave books with rough tops and unprotected is sure to produce stains and dirty margins.
The level crossings at Stretton and at the point where the A.L.R. crosses the main road south of Stretton are provided with gates; other crossings are unprotected, save for cattle-guards.

glosses: simple past and past participle of unprotect
adj. 无保护的，不设防的

examples.text: 無防備なコンピューターでは、ウイルスが起こりやすい。
